facts.fact: Techies reports Gabon's DGDI inaugurated an e-services portal where citizens can renew passports, national ID cards and residence permits online (three services named).

systems.owner: Direction Generale de la Documentation et de l'Immigration (DGDI)

facts.fact: Techies reports the DGDI portal includes an Espace Reclamation, an online space to file and follow complaints, newly inaugurated; no case numbers are given.
